source.quote_free_summary: If a couple withdraws after a round and before the next round begins, the chairman may at discretion replace it with the next eligible couple.

format: NDCA Sanctioned events, withdrawal between rounds
requirement: Kept separate from OD-08: replacement of a withdrawn couple between rounds is OD-21 and is not designed or built by the OD-08 withdrawal action.
enforcement_point: Not applicable to OD-08; A6 (no replacement, OD-18 A) remains the current behavior.
decision_refs: OD-08 (owner decision 2026-11-23, Option A; retrospective audit PR #795)
interpretation_notes: Permissive and discretionary; the chairman role mapping is not approved. Decided under OD-21, not here. Design only: no compliance claimed.
